title: File a Consumer Complaint
fee: As prescribed for the claim value
deadline: Check the current statutory limitation period and exceptions

steps.title: Collect invoice, payment proof, warranty and correspondence
Send a written grievance to the seller/service provider
Calculate and clearly state the relief requested
File before the commission with jurisdiction
Save acknowledgement and track the matter

title: Submit an RTI Request
authority: Public Information Officer of the concerned public authority
fee: Usually ₹10, subject to applicable rules and exemptions
deadline: Response timelines are governed by Section 7 and applicable rules

steps.title: Identify the correct public authority and PIO
Write precise numbered requests for existing records
Attach the prescribed fee or exemption proof
Prepare a first appeal if no proper response is received

title: Prepare a Police Complaint
authority: Officer in charge of the appropriate police station
deadline: Act promptly; urgent danger requires immediate emergency help

steps.title: Escalate through the lawful channel if required
